parameters.content:
## Shopify support — read/draft/handoff
Operator-attested test input only. Configure the two Header Auth credentials, Shopify endpoint and Talon endpoint. Default sample is synthetic, requires a visible fixture service. No Gmail send, mutation, action claim or payment credential. Use development store test orders only. All drafts require review.

## Boundaries
Shopify lookup is read-only and outside Talon. Sender match follows trusted operator verification; no raw email or body goes to the model. LLM sees minimized structured facts through Talon. Amount screening is not eligibility, approval or authorization. Refund execution disabled.
